sloka: स विसृष्टो बलवता बाणः स्वर्ण परिष्कृतः ।भित्त्वा सालान् गिरि प्रस्थम् सप्त भूमिम् विवेश ह ॥४-१२-३॥
transliteration: sa visṛṣṭo balavatā bāṇaḥ svarṇa pariṣkṛtaḥ ।bhittvā sālān giri prastham sapta bhūmim viveśa ha ॥4-12-3॥

translations.english: Released with great force, Rama's arrow embellished with gold pierced through the seven sala trees and splitting the mountain terrain entered the earth.
